At fixed old endpoints the action correction depends on q and T_prop, so it is not an endpoint-only constant.
Independent stationary substitution reconstructs the exact finite m=2 Starobinsky canonical momentum pushforward.
Under T_prop=i*z, the pushed canonical action equals the frozen configuration action with the declared Wick sign.
The frozen target is Starobinsky while the candidate BFV algebra is explicitly V=0.
T_prop, T_clock and N are distinct typed objects.
Fixed old (a,phi) endpoints differ from the endpoint-improved (T_clock,Phi) polarization, with no exact transform supplied.
The kept V=0 result leaves every finite-m2 BFV trajectory measure null.
No equality or deformation from the V=0 BFV source to the fixed-(a,phi) proper-time source is proved.
Appending an extra trace-gauge delta and FP factor to the unchanged proper-time source remains outside the replacement-source class.
The exact bosonic m=2 source still requires a same-model gauge/BFV determinant-line completion.
All three required upstream result ledgers are byte-pinned in the input manifest.
